Thank you for your interest in Cal Poly and Cal Poly Maritime Academy!

This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in major and support. Students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer. Cal Poly SLO and Solano campus has specific selection criteria for transfer students for admissions, and we encourage you to check the selection criteria for the major you are interested in. 

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major
  • Admissions website for current transfer admission requirements for San Luis Obispo campus
  • Cal Poly website for information on our campus


ACADEMIC INFORMATION

  • Business Administration requirements and flowchart can be viewed on the major page in the catalog, under the requirements tab. Information about concentrations, if applicable, are displayed on this page.
  • AP/IB/CLEP credit
  • Academic Advising  
  • Transfer Credits at Cal Poly
  • Cal Poly converted from the quarter system to semesters for Fall 2026. Find out more information on Semester conversion website | Specific College semester conversion websites 
  • Cal Poly San Luis Obispo and Cal Poly Maritime Academy has integrated into one university with two locations. Cal Poly Maritime Academy will be known as Solano Campus. Each respective campus will maintain separate assist.org accounts until Fall 2028, when our curriculum is fully integrated. However, the Business Administration major for both SLO and Solano have integrated. All requirements can be viewed on SLO's Assist account.
